name: ce_stationarypoints
questiontext:
Give an example of a function \(f(x)\) with a stationary point at \(x={{CT:0}}\).

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
In this question you are asked to find a function with the property that there is a stationary point at \(x={{CT:0}}\). That is to say that the gradient here will be zero. There are two main ways to go about this
  • Take a known function and graph shift it to put the stationary point in the correct place.
  • Take a function with a zero in the correct place an integrate it.
There are many different examples.
